# UCOS — Domain Catalog

**Artifact ID:** CTX-DOM-001
**Status:** Baseline scaffold (bootstrap) — **authoritative content generated by Prompt 03**.
**Purpose:** Register the bounded contexts of UCOS and their relationships.

> IMPORTANT: During bootstrap, **no domains are designed**. The entries below are
> **provisional candidates** to seed Prompt 03 (domain-architecture-generator).
> They are NOT ratified bounded contexts and carry no implementation authority.

## 3. Rules for Ratification
1. A candidate becomes a ratified bounded context only via Prompt 03.
2. Each ratified domain MUST receive a permanent Domain ID and registry entry.
3. Each ratified domain MUST trace to one or more capabilities in the Capability Catalog.
